name: sawbuck-reins
description: Sawbuck in Claude Code, one install: the guide band (watching / N caught / last verdict / live steer rate) plus five slash commands, /sawbuck-reins:check (try it now), /sawbuck-reins:watch (arm the Stop hook), /sawbuck-reins:context (ranked history for the files you touch), /sawbuck-reins:debt (the repo's live suppression debt), and /sawbuck-reins:status (the inventory). The mod itself runs no program.

judge.title: Live steering judge
judge.description: How the band's steer rate is scored each turn. native: one small call through Claude Code's own model API, on your own plan, zero setup, no key. off: no live steer rate from the plugin (score with the reins CLI instead: set SAWBUCK_JUDGE and run reins --append, see the reins-steering skill).

band.title: Guide band
band.description: Show the guide band above your prompt. Set to off if you show sawbuck in your own statusline instead (sawbuck statusline, below the prompt), so it does not appear twice. The judge still runs either way, so the statusline stays live.
